text: Here it is, the last match of the Finals!\c\nWho will earn the right to challenge the\nunbeatable Champion Leon?![VAR 0114(0018)]
Will it be the brilliant rising star,\nChallenger [VAR 0100(0000)]?[VAR 0114(0018)]
Or will it be the only Trainer that Champion Leon\ncalls his rival...\r\nthe tamer of dragons, Raihan?![VAR 0114(0018)]

You’re really something else, kid.
You’ve made it all the way here!\c
I guess that’s why the Champion himself
endorsed you, yeah?[VAR 0114(0017)]

Leon’s my rival—and he chose you. So I’ve got to
first prove I’m better than you if I’m to beat him!\c
I’ve reworked my whole team, and now we’re all
geared up for one-on-one battles![VAR 0114(0017)]

You might be thinking that you beat me
once already...\c
But if you think I’m the same Raihan you faced
during the Gym Challenge, you’ll soon regret it![VAR 0114(0017)]

My lovely Pokémon and I have become much
stronger than we were before...\c
But you just blew right past us!
Beyond anything I’d imagined![VAR 0114(0017)]

I’m still pretty young myself, but it just goes to
show that there’s always someone younger coming
up, reaching further than you ever dreamed...
And you’ve got your whole future ahead of you![VAR 0114(0017)]
Keep up the momentum!\nProve that Leon’s not unbeatable![VAR 0114(0017)]

Number [VAR 01C4(0001)], Challenger [VAR 0100(0000)],
has achieved a dazzling triumph!\c
The Trainer who was endorsed by the Champion
will now face the very man who endorsed h[VAR 1100(00FF,0202)]imer![VAR 0114(0018)]
